{{Quote|I have a 14-year-old son. I'd like to bring him with me.|Davo Sculdun, to [[Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="One Way Out" />}}
'''Stekan Sculdun''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Rix Road" /> who was the son of [[Davo Sculdun]].<ref name="One Way Out" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|110}}</ref> Sculdun wished for his son to meet [[Leida Mothma]] as she would soon be of age to be [[Marriage|married]] under [[Chandrilan]] customs.<ref name="One Way Out" />

A year later in [[4 BBY]], the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding ceremony of Stekan and Leida]] took place over three [[Standard day|days]] on Chandrila. During the evening of the first day, the pair had a fight after Stekan refused to hold Leida’s hand.<ref name="OYL">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> However, they continued forward with the traditional ceremony and were married.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>
